newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish WIG index seen at 18,122 in mid-year - poll.
newsitem.headline: Polish WIG index seen at 18,122 in mid-year - poll.

text.p: Polish brokerages see the main market's all-share WIG index rising to 18,122 points by the end of June and to 19,067 by the end of the year, a poll conducted by financial daily Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki showed.
Last month a similar poll showed brokerages expected the WIG index at 17,573 in mid-year and at 18,600 in in the end of the year.
The WIG index closed at 16,263.8 points on Friday.
